description: This file defines a service class 'SlotsOutputService_2024_04_15' responsible for processing and formatting time and range slots, including timezone adjustments and slot duration calculations, within a scheduling or booking system.

classes.name: SlotsOutputService_2024_04_15
classes.description: A service class for generating and formatting slot data with timezone support and slot duration calculation.

methods.name: getOutputSlots
methods.description: Main method to retrieve formatted slots, optionally adjusting for timezone and slot format.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Adjusts the 'time' field of TimeSlots to the specified timezone.

methods.name: setTimeZoneRange
methods.description: Adjusts 'startTime' and 'endTime' fields of RangeSlots to the specified timezone.

methods.name: formatSlots
methods.description: Formats available slots into start/end times, considering slot duration and format.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Retrieves slot duration either from parameter or by fetching event type duration from repository.
